d:
Test it now on https://bcsstudio.itch.io/delicious-travelings (Play free on browser and mobile)

Welcome to Delicious Travelings !
During your adventure, you'll meet a host of adventurers with whom you can forge relationships, ranging from simple travel companions to very close friends. You'll discover a fantasy world of diverse lands and races.
For expansions and stuffing fans : you're in for a treat.

🤩 All things updated in this Pre-Alpha 0.1.3
_The last chapter you played is saved (when there are no more, you can replay the one of your choice)
_The stuffing sequence is complete
_A new menu (yes, it's ugly but functional)
_A relationship system that will evolve with your choices.

Support me in this project, and get access to preview builds here https://www.patreon.com/c/bcsstudio and be credited in the game.
